# The examples list counts what each group page shows

Ownership: self-assigned (Vega), the builder named in the steward's decision below. No curated label: it is a gate item due before the copy lock (Sun 22 Nov, 18:00 CET).

## Context

Friday's gate read on #21140 ([Ada, 13:40 UTC](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7041152372)), item 7, named by both readers: "30 live examples, 1 from other groups" needs reading twice, and Trees and Drag & Drop show no number in the list. Clio, the epic's steward, decided the counts after a cold two-reader comparison of three versions ([#21140 comment 7044472767](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7044472767)).

## The Problem

The list counts a group's home records only (the rule of #21130, kept by AC-3 of #21509), so its numbers add up to the overview's headline. A group that also shows borrowed cards reads lower than its page: Apps shows 6, and its page has 11 cards. A group without home records shows no number, which reads as zero next to a TreeGrid card. In a production build, ten of the 21 groups borrow, 20 placements in all.

## The Architectural Reality

- `ExampleGroup.countText` and `ExampleGroup.countLabel` (`apps/portal/model/ExampleGroup.mjs`) render the list's figure, and the words for the entry's `aria-label` and the group page's line.
- `GroupIndex#createEntry` (`apps/portal/view/examples/GroupIndex.mjs`) renders the list. With a filter on, it reads `matchCounts` (`home`, `cross`, `total`) and shows home matches only.
- `GroupPage` (line 176) writes `countLabel` and the group's sentence as the page's line.
- `MainContainerController#publishGroups` keeps `count` (home) and `crossCount` (borrowed) per group, and the overview's headline sums `count`. The data keeps both quantities; only what the list and the page show changes.
- Design authority: Clio, steward of #21140, [comment 7044472767](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7044472767): "a group's number counts its home records plus the ones it borrows"; "A group page's line: the plain total"; "Under the list, one line: '121 examples in all. Some appear in more than one group.' The number comes from the catalog." It reverses #21130's home-only rule and AC-3 of #21509, and brings back a line where #21509 removed one.

## The Fix

1. `ExampleGroup.countText` and `countLabel` count home plus borrowed records: "11" and "11 live examples".
2. `GroupIndex`: with a filter on, a group's number and its label are its total matches ("3", "Drag & Drop, 3 matching examples"). Under the list, one line: "<N> examples in all. Some appear in more than one group.", where N is the published total that the overview's headline counts. The line shows while some group borrows and no filter is on.
3. JSDoc of `publishGroups`, `countText` and `countLabel`: the data keeps home and borrowed apart, and the list and the page show their sum.
4. `GroupIndex.css`: the line's rule.
5. Specs: the unit spec's count-label, phone-index and filter expectations; the e2e test that every count adds up to the headline becomes: every number equals what its page shows, and the line states the headline's total.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: In a production build, every list entry's number equals the live examples its page shows: Apps 11, Trees 2, Drag & Drop 3.
- [ ] AC-2: A group page's line starts with the plain total, for example "11 live examples · …".
- [ ] AC-3: Under the list: "121 examples in all. Some appear in more than one group.", its number equal to the overview headline's for the selected build; "All examples" carries no number.
- [ ] AC-4: With a filter on, each number is the group's matching total and its label says "N matching examples"; the line under the list is not shown.
- [ ] AC-5: The unit spec and `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` pass, and the PR records the rendered list, read from the running Portal at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, before and after.

## Out of Scope

- The "All examples" row's name and number: open in Saturday's whole read on #21140.
- A borrowed card's group name on a group page, Apps' and Trees' sentences, and the big-grid button's wording (seen by both readers, not decided).
- The build control (finding 3, Ada) and the phone header (finding 9, Maryam).

* feat(portal): the examples list counts what each group page shows (#21590)

A group's number in the examples list now counts its home examples plus the
ones other groups lend it, so Apps reads 11, Trees 2 and Drag & Drop 3, and a
group page's line gives the same plain total. One line under the list,
"121 examples in all. Some appear in more than one group.", explains why the
numbers add up to more than the headline. It stays out while a filter is on,
whose numbers count total matches.

This follows the examples steward's decision on #21140 and reverses the
home-only count rule of #21130 and #21509.
